journeys.name: sell a covered call on a position I hold

steps.sees: the cockpit: the account switcher, Overview · Activity
steps.ears: WHEN a member with one linked account opens Profile, the app shall open that account's cockpit on Overview.
steps.judge: can this reader tell what to do next in ten seconds?

steps.sees: the Overview: net worth, then the positions blotter — EEM, Guidance on the row
steps.ears: WHEN the member opens Overview, the app shall show the held positions with a way into each one's guidance, even when net worth cannot be read.
steps.judge: can this reader tell which position to act on?

steps.sees: the Overview: net worth, then one card per position — EEM's card is the way in (it opens the position on Trade, where Guidance is a tab)
steps.ears: WHEN the member opens Overview on a phone, the app shall show each held position as a card that opens it on Trade, even when net worth cannot be read.
steps.judge: can this reader tell which position to act on?

steps.sees: the desk's blotter: EEM, Guidance on the row; they click it
steps.ears: WHEN the member opens their desk, the app shall show each held position with a way into its guidance.
steps.judge: can this reader tell which position to act on?

steps.sees: the desk's positions as cards; the EEM card is the way into Trade
steps.ears: WHEN the desk renders at 390px, the app shall show each position as one tappable card into Trade.
steps.judge: can this reader tell which position to act on?

steps.sees: Trade, EEM prefilled, the Guidance pane (offline: 'No live quote for EEM — nothing to advise on')
steps.ears: WHEN the member follows a position into Trade, the app shall open Trade with that symbol and its guidance pane.
steps.judge: can this reader tell whether to sell the call today?

steps.sees: no back link on the stage — the rail's '← Back to account' left with the rail (#3807 slice 2a); the topbar's Profile tab always lands on /accounts now (#3807 slice 2b), the book once onboarding is complete
steps.ears: WHEN the member wants to return from Trade to their book, the app shall link back to the cockpit they came from.
steps.judge: does the reader land where they started?

steps.sees: the docked bench: ticket left, chart right, orders below — no Chain entry
steps.ears: WHEN Trade is docked at desktop width, the app shall offer an entry to the standalone options chain.
steps.known_gap: dead end 8 — docked Trade has no UI entry to the standalone Chain (app/src/routes/trade.tsx:113 lists it; the docked layout never renders the switch)
steps.judge: can the reader find the chain from here?

steps.sees: the Chain pane: 'Pick a symbol on the Ticket to browse its options chain.' — no input here
steps.ears: WHEN a pane needs a symbol it does not have, the app shall offer the symbol input in that pane.

expect.text: Pick a symbol on the Ticket

steps.known_gap: dead end 3 — the Chain / Chart / Guidance panes say 'Pick a symbol on the Ticket…' with no input of their own (app/src/shell/chain-section.tsx:125, chart-section.tsx:126, guidance-section.tsx:112)
steps.judge: can this reader tell what to do next in ten seconds?

steps.sees: the activity feed — fills, orders, the kinds chips
steps.ears: WHEN the member opens Activity, the app shall show the feed with the newest event first.
steps.judge: can the reader find today's fill?

steps.sees: the cockpit — nothing links to the desk page for this same account
steps.ears: WHEN the member is on their cockpit, the app shall link the other view of the same account (the desk) or fold it in.
steps.known_gap: dead end 6 — /accounts never links your own desk; two profile concepts, no bridge (app/src/routes/accounts.tsx; app/src/shell/desk-rail.tsx)
steps.judge: does the reader know there are two pages for one account?

steps.sees: the desk: its link row (Overview · Pulse · Settings), tiles, blotter, New trade; nothing on the stage links the cockpit
steps.ears: WHEN the member is on their own desk, the app shall link back to their cockpit.
steps.known_gap: dead end 6 — the desk's link row never links /accounts (app/src/shell/desk-rail.tsx); only the topbar's Profile tab does — 2d gives /u/:id its own head
steps.judge: does the reader land where they started?

steps.sees: 'Prove the play by hand, then arm it' — the WIP chapter, Arm · soon disabled
steps.ears: WHEN the member opens the Profile's Playbooks chapter, the app shall relate it to the Playbook Store (one playbook system, not two).
steps.known_gap: dead end 7 — two unrelated 'Playbooks': the Profile page's Milestones chapter with a disabled Arm (app/src/shell/playbooks-chapter.tsx:41) and R&D's subscribe-able store (app/src/shell/playbooks-section.tsx:84)
steps.judge: does the reader know which Playbooks this is?

steps.sees: the Playbook Store; 'Subscribe as' in the rail at desktop, folded on a phone
steps.ears: WHEN the member opens R&D → Playbooks, the app shall show the store with a subscribe-as account picker.
steps.judge: does the reader know which Playbooks this is?
